title: Igusa’s Standard p-Adic Monodromy Conjecture
exact_target: Do the actual poles of every relevant $p$-adic zeta integral predict local complex monodromy eigenvalues, outside finitely many primes depending only on the polynomial?

sources.citation: Willem Veys, Introduction to the monodromy conjecture, arXiv:2403.03343v1, Conjecture 2.12(1). Denef, Bourbaki exposé 741, supplies historical corroboration with a separately mentioned test-function extension.
